frequency_question: How frequently are capital buffer modifications initiated, processed through notice-and-comment or internal voting channels, and finalized within a sub-two-year horizon?
membership_rule: Includes any formal regulatory proceeding regarding countercyclical capital buffer adjustments by the central bank board of governors; excludes routine capital requirement reviews that do not alter the countercyclical buffer.
provenance_note: claimed 1 hits but 2 of 3 cases are marked hit; rate recomputed from the cases
coverage_note: 3 named; represents the total population of active CCyB level adjustments by the Federal Reserve since the framework's creation.
known_gaps: Small population size due to the novel nature of the countercyclical capital buffer instrument introduced post-2008.
skeleton: Regulatory rule-making cycles since framework inception multiplied by the fraction resulting in active buffer alterations within a short timeframe.
multiplier: 3 major framework adjustment periods evaluated, 2 resulted in active level changes (one establishment, one reduction), 0 resulted in an increase above 0% after initial setup.
validity_reason: The regulatory framework and voting structures for the Federal Reserve remain stable over multi-year horizons barring major legislative overhauls.
